title: First Day on the Danfo
brief: Dawn at Oshoja. Shina Garage's boys came for the levy again. Baba Driver has work for whoever can count change.
standout: Your first shift as a conductor: three stops, fares, change, and the agbero.

objectives.sub: E for the next line, F to skip

say.speaker: Oshoja, dawn
lines: Shina's boy: Màmá, owó ìlẹ̀ yẹn kò tíì pé. Ti ọkọ yín ni.  (Mama, that levy is still not complete. It is your husband's.)
Iya Tobi: Fẹ́mi ti kú. Kí lẹ tún fẹ́ kí n tà?  (Femi is dead. What else do you want me to sell?)
Shina's boy: Shina ní ọjọ́ Ẹtì. Lẹ́yìn ọjọ́ Ẹtì, a ò ní kan ilẹ̀kùn mọ́.  (Shina says Friday. After Friday we will not knock again.)
Iya Tobi: Túndé, ọmọ mi, má bá wọn sọ̀rọ̀. Lọ bá Bàbá Awakọ̀ ní páàkì.  (Tunde, my child, do not talk to them. Go to Baba Driver at the park.)
Tunde: Màá rí owó náà, Màmá. Mo búra.  (I will find the money, Mama. I swear.)

objectives.sub: Meet him at the motor park
